provision: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA)
applies_to: employees with 12 months and 1,250 hours, employers with 50+ employees
notes: 12 workweeks in a 12-month period; birth, placement for adoption or foster care; checked against the saved statute text; the 2018 floor is in the floor_2018 columns
floor_2018_basis: statute text; leave length unchanged since 1993
floor_2018_quote: an eligible employee shall be entitled to a total of 12 workweeks of leave during any 12-month period
floor_2018_note: Eligibility: 12 months' service and 1,250 hours (29 USC 2611(2)); first-year faculty excluded. Birth and other parent alike (a)(1)(A) birth, (B) placement; bonding by either parent.

provision: California Family Rights Act (CFRA)
applies_to: employers with 5+ employees; 12 months and 1,250 hours
notes: 12 workweeks; concurrent with FMLA except pregnancy disability; checked against the saved statute text

provision: Pregnancy Disability Leave (PDL)
notes: up to four months; in addition to CFRA; checked against the saved statute text

provision: Connecticut Family and Medical Leave Act (CT FMLA)
applies_to: employers with 75+ employees (31-51kk(4)); not the state or municipalities
notes: 2018: 16 workweeks in any 24-month period (31-51ll(a)(1)), incl. birth and adoption; a couple at the same employer may be limited to 16 in total; the 2018 Supplement (Wayback 2018-10-19) does not amend 31-51kk to 31-51qq, so the 2017 revision text governs in 2018; checked against the saved statute text; the 2018 floor is in the floor_2018 columns
floor_2018_quote: an eligible employee shall be entitled to a total of sixteen workweeks of leave during any twenty-four-month period
floor_2018_note: Unpaid, job-protected; 2022 amendments (12 weeks in 12 months, CT PL) are after 2018.

provision: New Jersey Family Leave Insurance (FLI)
notes: 2018: up to six weeks of family temporary disability leave benefits per period and per 12 months (43:21-39(b)(2)-(3)), for bonding with a newborn or newly placed child; rate two-thirds of the average weekly wage, capped (43:21-40); NJ DOL linked this July 2014 text as current in Dec 2017 (Wayback); 12 weeks only from 2020 (P.L.2019, c.37, general knowledge); checked against the saved statute text

provision: New Jersey Temporary Disability Insurance (TDI)
source_citation: N.J.S.A. 43:21-25 et seq. (NJ DOL text, July 2014: 2018_31_nj_tdb_fli_law_july2014)
notes: 2018: benefits for the individual's own disability, incl. pregnancy, up to 26 weeks per period (43:21-39(b)(1)); rate two-thirds of the average weekly wage, capped (43:21-40); private plans allowed; checked against the saved statute text

provision: New Jersey Family Leave Act
applies_to: employers with 50+ employees in 2018 (N.J.A.C. 13:14-1.2); 30+ only from 2019
source_citation: N.J.S.A. 34:11B-1 et seq.; N.J.A.C. 13:14 (NJ DCR regulations, current as of 2008-08-29: 2018_32_nj_fla_regulations_njac13-14)
notes: 2018: up to 12 weeks of family leave in any 24-month period (N.J.A.C. 13:14-1.4(a)), incl. birth and adoption; checked against the regulations, not the statute text (the statute itself was not found in an archived official copy); checked against the saved statute text; the 2018 floor is in the floor_2018 columns
floor_2018_quote: Family leave may be taken for up to 12 weeks within any 24-month period
floor_2018_note: Bonding leave; the birth parent's own pregnancy disability is not FLA leave.

provision: Oregon Family Leave Act (OFLA)
notes: 2018: 12 weeks of family leave a year (659A.162(1)), incl. parental leave (659A.159(1)(a)); plus up to 12 weeks of pregnancy-disability leave in addition (659A.162(3)(a)); parental leave narrowed in 2024; checked against the saved statute text

provision: Tennessee Maternity Leave Act (TMLA)
applies_to: employers with 100+ full-time employees; 12 consecutive months full-time
notes: up to four months for adoption, pregnancy, childbirth, nursing; with or without pay at employer discretion; checked against the saved statute text

provision: Virginia paid parental leave for state employees
applies_to: employees covered by the Virginia Personnel Act (classified, restricted, salaried at-will); teaching and research staff of state educational institutions are exempt from the Act (Va. Code 2.2-2905(8)), so tenure-stream faculty are not covered
source_citation: DHRM Policy 4.21 Parental Leave, effective 2018-06-26 (2018_07); Va. Code 2.2-2905 (2018_15)
notes: 8 weeks paid (per Policy 4.21); not in force before 2018-06-26. Universities may adopt their own faculty policies; code those from the institution's documents; checked against the saved statute text

applies_to: employers with 100+ employees, including the State and its instrumentalities; employees with 6+ consecutive months of service
notes: 4 weeks per calendar year upon birth or adoption of a child (or to care for a family member with a serious health condition); may be taken intermittently (398-3); the sections saved do not make it paid (substitution of paid leave, 398-4, not saved); checked against the saved statute text

applies_to: all employers, including the State and its instrumentalities (HRS 392-3); 392-5 lists no exclusion for Hawaii public employment
notes: disability includes pregnancy; weekly benefit 58% of average weekly wage up to a maximum (392-22); a statutory insurance benefit, not employer pay.
